sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders come into this fixture in excellent form, with five consecutive wins before a recent draw, and will be heavy favourites against Alsager Town, who remain rooted to the bottom with just 4 points from 10 matches and are winless in their last five outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a mid-table clash, with Stafford's recent draw suggesting they may be losing momentum. AFC Bridgnorth, third and in strong form with five consecutive wins before a recent loss, host struggling Eccleshall, who have won only one of their last three. Wolverhampton Casuals face Wednesfield Community in a battle between mid-table sides both capable of good form. Foley Meir welcome Bilston Town, a fixture between two well-matched teams in the middle of the pack; Bilston are in fine recent form with back-to-back wins. In the lower half, Crewe host Allscott Heath in a contest between clubs with mixed recent records, while struggling Shawbury United welcome Barnton, who have shown inconsistency. Market Drayton Town face New Mills, both dealing with indifferent form lately. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to in-form Telford Town, though both remain among the division's weakest performers. Finally, Widnes Town, pointless away from home and among the league's poorest, visit Brereton Social in what looks a difficult assignment for the visitors.
